EGAY Office of the Mayor Municipality of Gigaquit Province of Surigao del Norte Dear Mayor Egay: 102 This has reference to your Office's request for opinion on whether soft infrastructure projects may be funded by the 20% development fund of the annual internal revenue allotment (IRA). According to you, your Office was informed by the Provincial Budget Office (PBO) of Surigao del Norte that only hard infrastructure projects may be funded by the 20% development fund of the annual IRA. This was upon the advice of the Commission on Audit (COA) "to avoid disallowance of disbursements in the 20% development fund which are not for hard infrastructure projects". In your opinion, such interpretation is narrow considering that the provision of M.C. No. 2010-138 in relation to DBM-DILG JMC No. I, s. 2005 dated 20 September 2005 do not limit the use of the 20 % development fund for purely hard infrastructure projects. In view of the absence of a citation of the basis of the COA opinion and the Department's lack of authority to issue an interpretation or opinion on a rule or regulation issued by another government agency, -if any, we shall answer your query only in relation to the interpretation of this Department's issuances particularly the recent 13 April 2011 issued DBM-DILG JMC No. 2011-1, which amends DILG-DBM JMC No. 1, s. 2005 and M.C. No. 2010-138. DBM-DILG JMC No. 2011-1 do not limit the use of the 20% development fund to hard infrastructure projects. Furthermore, no such qualification is found in Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government of 1991", specifically under Section 287 thereof. In the absence of any law limiting the use of the 20% development fund to hard infrastructure projects, we opine that same also covers soft infrastructure projects. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, Director III
